aggregation: Relative band-bin PSD sums; median over retained epoch-channel cells
artifact_screen: Reject a 2-second epoch if >=3 channels ptp>200uV, any channel ptp>300uV, or any channel std<0.5uV
cohort: All frozen CANDIDATE FTD participants and the same selected controls as AD study
inner_cv: 3 subject-stratified folds on outer training only
limitation: Previously examined dataset; no external validation; not preregistered
minimum_usable: At least 50 percent clean epochs and at least 10 epochs per block
primary: First-minute-trained model tested on five held-out minute positions; within-recording class reversals
uncertainty: Participant-stratified bootstrap, preserving repetitions and shared controls
welch: Hann, nperseg=1000, noverlap=0, constant detrend, density
